title: Lifecycle Composition in Build Stewardship
summary: Lifecycle composition is named as a third category of integration risk in build stewardship, alongside test-suite composition (Composable Tests) and structural-boundary verification (Integration Verification + Stewardship Tier 1), covering risk at lifecycle boundaries where ownership and mutation rights over shared mutable state are ambiguous. The build skill is extended at three existing anchor points: a Lifecycle Composition subsection in Composable Tests (design-time prompt), a lifecycle-sequence verification paragraph in Step 5 Integration Verification (verification-time anchor), and a new sub-item 6e "Shared mutable state" under Stewardship Tier 1's Test quality item (review-time detector). The extension is scoped to the build skill only, anchored per Invariant 8 in the Skill-Structure Layer.
workflow_point: BUILD stewardship — Composable Tests, Step 5 Integration Verification, Tier 1 review
mechanism: three-anchor Lifecycle Composition category (design-time, verification-time, review-time)

links.note: other composable skills (debug, refactor, review) compose with build through ADR-048's mode-shift composition and inherit build's lifecycle-composition orientation without duplicating its checklist, which is why this ADR scopes the category to build alone
